results.name: Flood in Pakistan
results.reason: On the 15 August 2025 at 00:00, a flash flood event during the monsoon season was reported to have affected Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces, Pakistan. The event was on-going and spreading, with damage reported to buildings, infrastructure, and agriculture. Loss of life has been recorded, with over 300 fatalities. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation and flood extent emergency mapping.
